headline: When will you be debt-free?
lede: Add a debt and your payment to see how long it takes.
caption: An extra $100 a month saves $763.64 in interest.

pin.title: Debt-Free Date Calculator: When Will You Pay It Off?
pin.description: A $4,000 card at 22% APR takes 37 months and $1,541.63 in interest at $150 a month. At $250 a month it is gone in 20 months with $777.99 in interest. Enter your own debts in the free calculator to find your debt-free date for 2027 and beyond.
pin.alt: Debt-free date calculator: a $4,000 balance at 22% APR with $250 a month is paid off in 20 months with $777.99 in interest.
